name: FOMO Notifications
author: wpzinc

sections.description:
FOMO Notifications displays attractive, non-intrusive notifications of recent purchases to your site visitors. By showing real customer activity, you can build trust and create FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) to boost your sales.

Perfect For

  • Online stores looking to increase conversions
  • E-commerce sites wanting to build social proof
  • WooCommerce store owners seeking to enhance user experience
  • Businesses aiming to showcase recent customer activity

How It Works

The plugin monitors your WooCommerce orders in real-time. When a purchase is made, it’s added to the notification queue.

Visitors see elegant popups showing recent purchase activity.

Documentation

Full Plugin documentation can be found here.

Configuration

Navigate to FOMO Notifications in WordPress

General Settings

The general settings section covers:

  • Number of notifications: The maximum number of notifications to display.
  • Loop notifications: Once the notifications have been displayed, enabling this option will go back to the first notification, starting again.
  • Source: The source of notifications. Currently, WooCommerce Orders are supported. Other notification types will follow in later updates.

WooCommerce Settings

The WooCommerce settings section covers:

  • Maximum Order Age: The maximum age of Orders to include. This is based on the Order’s creation date.
  • Order Status: The order status(es) to include in the notification.

To select one or more statuses, Ctrl / Cmd + click the statuses.

Save Settings

Once the settings are configured, click the Save Changes button.

Navigate to the frontend site, to see your notifications!
sections.installation:
1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New Plugin in WordPress
  2. Type FOMO Notifications in the Search Plugins search field, and press the Enter key
  3. Click Install Now beside FOMO Notifications
  4. Once installed, click Activate
sections.faq:
Where can I find the Plugin’s Documentation?

Full Plugin documentation can be found here.

I don’t see any WooCommerce sales notification on my site

  • Ensure any server or plugin caching solution has cleared its cache
  • Ensure at least one WooCommerce Order exists, and its status matches the status(es) chosen in the WooCommerce Settings section of the FOMO Notifications Plugin.

Is this compatible with my theme?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with any WordPress theme.

Will this slow down my site?

No, the plugin is optimized for performance with minimal impact on page load times.
